subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: addressing as sir the nobleman asked sheikh saadi why he was putting up the food in his pocket he also asked him why he did not eat sheikh saadi replied that he was doing the right thing because his dress deserved those rich dishes the noble man said that he did not understand what he meant to say and he was sorry Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Use capitals and punctuation marks: Addressing as sir, the nobleman asked Sheikh Saadi why he was putting up the food in his pocket. He also asked him why he did not eat. Sheikh Saadi replied that he was doing the right thing because his dress deserved those rich dishes. The noble man said that he did not understand what he meant to say and so he was sorry. ● Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
